title: Looking for a 2D Character Illustrator
content: Looking for a 2D Character Illustrator. We'll provide character design concepts. You'll create high-quality, commercial-use illustrations with poses and backgrounds. Quality level matching the attached characters. Requirements: - Japanese anime art style (see attached images) - Experience with 2D game character art - Faithful to the original design (hair, outfit, colors) - work needs to match the quality of the attached examples (especially the coloring). To apply: Send your portfolio. Feel free to reach out!

author: Ash Milite
title: LOOKING FOR AN ARTIST for character art cards
content: LOOKING FOR AN ARTIST! 🖤 I’m looking for an artist to work with one of my author clients on character art cards for multiple books. We have quite a few projects in the works, so I’d love to connect with someone interested in an ongoing working relationship and multiple commissions! Here’s what we’re looking for: - Character art/cards for books - Budget: Under $100 per art piece - Multiple pieces across multiple books - Must be available to start now! - NO AI-GENERATED ART. Human artists only, please! If you’re an artist whose style might be a good fit, please drop your portfolio or commission sheet in the comments, along with your pricing and current availability! If you know an artist who might be interested, please tag them or share this post. We’d love to find someone whose art we can keep coming back to as these projects grow!

title: Looking for Pokemon character art for me, man and pup
content: Looking for an artist who can turn me my man and my pup into pokemon characters! TIA! Don’t really have a budget, willing to pay anything for great art!
